abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cursor usage endpoint.
error.forbidden: Cursor denied access to usage (permission denied / HTTP 403). Use a Cursor user API key for an account with Grok Bot access, not a team admin API key. See https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/authentication
error.invalid_auth: Cursor rejected the credential (unauthenticated / HTTP 401). The key may be invalid, revoked, or the wrong type. Use a Cursor user API key, not a team admin API key. See https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/authentication
error.invalid_response: Cursor returned an unexpected key-exchange or usage response. Try again later or report an API compatibility issue.
error.rate_limited: The usage endpoint rate limited the request. Try again shortly.
error.session_cookie: Session tokens and cookies are not accepted. Enter a Cursor user API key, not a team admin API key. See https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/authentication
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the API key.
error.missing_api_key: No API key was entered. Enter a Cursor user API key (not a team admin key). See https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/authentication
